title: Prepare Your Home Before Work Begins
summary: A few simple preparations can make the project safer, cleaner and easier for everyone in the home.
body:
## Clear personal items
Remove valuables and small personal items from the work area and nearby surfaces.

## Pets and children
Keep pets and children away from active work zones, tools and materials.

## Access
Confirm parking, entry instructions, elevator requirements, gate access and any building rules before the first workday.

## Utilities
Some projects require access to water or electrical power. Any planned shutdowns should be discussed before work begins.

## Dust and protection
We plan protection around the agreed work area, but sensitive belongings should still be moved away from construction zones whenever possible.

## Communication
Keep one primary contact available for project questions, selections and approvals so the job can keep moving.
seoTitle: How to Prepare Your Home for Renovation Work
seoDescription: Simple homeowner preparation tips for access, belongings, pets, utilities and communication before construction starts.
